source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1930, p. 7 ("Belfast Rural Council: retiring members all re-elected")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names and divisions read on the page image of the Belfast News-Letter nominations report of 8 May 1930

note: Nomination-day report for the nine divisions of Belfast rural district. Every retiring member was nominated again and returned unopposed, so there was no contest. The round is filed on the rural districts' polling day in early June 1930 (queue nominal 29 May). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
